verdict.rationale: Mercury only announces that 'soon' a full accounting API will expose every core Books action, so API parity with the UI is a roadmap promise rather than a shipped capability. The one programmatic claim, invoicing, belongs to an adjacent product surface and does not show parity for Books bookkeeping actions. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
